column1: # Homographs: the default reading and rules by context, made by hand from a frequency list.
#   @NAME<TAB>words by commas               - a class of words
#   %NAME<TAB>rules with the variants A and B - a template of rules
# A rule: condition[&condition...]=>variant; rules are separated by "; ", the first one that holds wins. The variant
# "?" stops the rules: the word is read as if none held.
# Conditions: p: the previous word, n: the next one (within a piece without punctuation; ^: no word on the left, $: none
# on the right); pp: the word before the previous; nn: the word after the next; ps:/ns: the ending of the previous/next
# word; pst:/nst: its beginning; rs: the ending of some word further right in the same piece (a predicate: «всё из
# этого альбома добавлено»). Values are separated by commas, @NAME is a class. «p:^=>X; pst:@ANY=>X» means "X in every
# other case" (the word does not reach the model).
# 'е' and 'ё' compare equal. A variant is the word with «+» before the stressed vowel; its letters may differ from the
